name: @dsh-scholar/research-orchestrator
description: DSH Research OS — Durable Research Orchestrator (v2 §8): state-driven poller over the Research Kernel projection API. Advances projects from their current status toward the next Human Gate and pauses there. Self-contained: own SQLite action store (node:sqlite), talks to the Kernel only over HTTP; no dependency on long-lived sessions or in-process Tasks.
